channel.title: Local News Wire Broadcast Feed
channel.description: Approved local stories in broadcast order

item.description: A coastal storm overnight brought freezing rain and strong winds to Vermont and the North Country. High Wind Warnings are still in effect for Bennington and eastern Rutland counties. Power outages and slippery roads are possible, especially in mountainous areas.

Green Mountain Power, Vermont Electric Cooperative, Town of Stowe and Washington Electric Co-op in Vermont report three thousand nine hundred seventeen customers without power overnight in Vermont. Green Mountain Power has not posted a restoration estimate yet.

The Holiday Train stopped in Port Henry, New York, on Thanksgiving to collect donations for local shelters. Free concerts were held to encourage giving. The train has raised over twenty-eight million dollars and five million pounds of food since it began.

New York Governor Kathy Hochul delayed Medicaid work requirements until June next year. The rules require recipients to show eighty hours a month of work or education, with some exemptions. The state is upgrading systems and hopes for federal changes to ease these rules.
